_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.84: Simulator recording and sweep results

- Start sweep saves and closes an existing recording automatically after the queue and hardware checks pass. A failed recording close prevents trial startup.
- Simulator includes Open recording folder, opening the active/latest sweep or the recordings folder.
- Preview shades successful trial rows green and aborted/failed rows red. Status text remains visible; new sweeps clear prior outcomes.
- Every sweep generates sweep_results.csv: one row per planned trial with simulator settings, cuff/mandrel, measured Arduino and NI channel statistics, ProSim observations, detected Smart MAP/fallback, status and raw-file references. Aborted and unrun trials remain distinguishable; absent measurements stay blank.
- Acquisition checks use native NI sample freshness and successful-read heartbeat instead of GUI delivery timestamps. Genuine acquisition stalls still stop the sweep and preserve partial data. The previously observed approximately 11-second native-delivery pauses remain under investigation.

Validation: 104 focused tests passed on this branch; layout audit, mocked GUI smoke, legacy checks and packaged panel checks passed. Real Default bench validation confirmed recording handoff and separate native files, then ended on operator STOP; it did not complete the two-trial protocol run. No firmware, PID, calibration equations, safety thresholds or branch preset changes.
